_comment: Models keprompt knows about that LiteLLM does not carry. `keprompt models update` overwrites
model_prices_and_context_window.json wholesale, so anything declared here survives it.
Fields use LiteLLM's own names, because that is what the loader reads.
Everything below is mode=ldm: an LDM (decision model), invoked by .evaluate rather
than .exec. They all speak the same wire protocol -- POST /v1/systemone taking {state, model,
questions} and returning {model, answers, usage} -- so the only thing that differs between
them is the base URL and whether auth is required.
max_input_tokens is 0 where the publisher has not stated a limit. Costs are per token.
